name: Pedro Pathing
description: Path following using Bezier curves, with tuning OpModes.

versions.notes: Same pairing as the Pedro Pathing Quickstart. tuning 1.0.2 has a crash (see known issues).

postInstall: Copy the pedro package from the Pedro Pathing Quickstart (TeamCode/src/main/java/org/firstinspires/ftc/teamcode/pedro) into TeamCode, then follow the tuning guide.

conflicts.reason: com.pedropathing:ftc is the 2.x line; Pedro Pathing 3 uses com.pedropathing:revhub. Remove the old artifact when upgrading.

knownIssues.summary: AutoTune crashes while TeamCode loads: the robot stops after a Sloth hot reload and AutoTune lists no procedures.
knownIssues.details: TunerScanner in com.pedropathing:tuning 1.0.2 calls Map.putIfAbsent(...).add(...), which throws a NullPointerException the first time it scans a class with @Tuner methods (usually Tuning.java). The tuning library always brings in the Sloth runtime, which treats this as a fatal loading error: loading TeamCode fails when the app starts, and after a hot reload the robot stops with "User code threw an uncaught exception". Versions 1.0.0 and 1.0.1 do not have this code; 1.0.3-beta.1 fixes it. The Pedro Pathing Quickstart uses 1.0.1.

upgradeNotes.text: Pedro Pathing 3 replaces com.pedropathing:ftc with com.pedropathing:revhub. SolversLib 0.3.6 or newer is required for its Pedro Pathing module.

verification.notes: Artifacts are published on Maven Central; the documentation also adds the Dairy Foundation repository. The tuning crash was found from a robot log and confirmed in the 1.0.0, 1.0.1, 1.0.2 and 1.0.3-beta.1 sources.
